description: Permit holds, pauses and local moratoria that apply at a Texas address or coordinate, or statewide when no location is given: who imposed it, what project types and permit types it covers, since when, what ends it, and the source with a verbatim quote. Use when someone asks whether permits are frozen, about the TCEQ data center permit pause, or whether a county or city has a moratorium on data centers, battery storage, solar or crypto mining. Free gives the count; Pro the detail.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.
